purpose: Increase structural separation among G01..G40 seed candidates before human review by replacing raw 4-bit angular decisions with a Hamming(7,4)-derived 7-bit angular code.
supersedesForReview: glyph-genesis-hnk40-seed-family.v1.json V1.1 remains provenance; V1.2 is the preferred structural review family.

codingLaw.input: column0 = 0..9 represented as data bits d1 d2 d3 d4
codingLaw.codeword: p1 p2 d1 p4 d2 d3 d4
codingLaw.property: The full Hamming(7,4) code has minimum Hamming distance 3; the selected first 10 data words retain minimum distance 3.

pathLaw.angularRule: code bit 0 => ANGULAR_NEXT; code bit 1 => ANGULAR_PREV

governance: Error-correcting code use is a structural spacing technique only. It does not assign semantic or mystical meaning.
